paper_title: Search for ultralight axion dark matter in a side-band analysis of a 199Hg free-spin precession signal
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (axion-nucleon derivative coupling as defined in Eq. (3)/(13) of the paper; NOT converted to dimensionless g_an)
notes: New 95% C.L. exclusion on axion-nucleon coupling g_aNN from sideband analysis of 199Hg free-spin-precession at PSI, covering 1e-16 eV < m_a < 1e-13 eV. Only the peak sensitivity g_aNN ~ 3.5e-6 GeV^-1 (at the low-frequency end near the carrier fHg=7.88 Hz sidebands) is given explicitly in text; no numerical table provided. The other data points are approximate, obtained by scaling linearly with axion frequency per Eq. (13) (g ∝ (fi - fHg)/amplitude with roughly flat noise floor), so they should be treated as an estimated envelope of the exclusion curve in Fig. 4. Note sensitivity gaps at multiples of fHg and a dip near 4 Hz are not captured. The 199Hg system is primarily sensitive to g_ann (factor ~10 weaker dependence on g_app), so AxionNeutron is appropriate. Coupling values are in GeV^-1; multiply by ~2*m_n (1.879 GeV) if dimensionless g_an is needed downstream. rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed (conservative lower bound). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 4))
